title: External exact quantity
description: Exact decimal-string quantity and UOM pair exposed by X03B read facades. The value has at most three decimal places and is NOT guaranteed to be a whole number, even for a counted unit such as hộp or thùng; the rule KHO-Q1 (a counted unit is whole) is not applied by the provider today. See docs/m3-allocation-integration-notes.md section 8.

value.description: Decimal string with at most three decimal places. A fractional value such as "150.5" is possible for hộp and thùng; whole numbers are not guaranteed (docs/m3-allocation-integration-notes.md section 8).
